occurrences.note: The notation shows the top notes of the left hand. Discovery calls this LM002 (strong). The reviewers' hints, which are guesses and not names: Ring, Fafner, gods in crisis; the Ring, Alberich, curse, freedom; Fafner, dragon, hoard.

libretto.text: keinem Glücklichen lache sein lichter Glanz!
libretto.translation: let its bright gleam laugh for no happy one!

libretto.text: Wer ihn besitzt, den sehre die Sorge,
libretto.translation: Whoever possesses it, may care sear him,

libretto.text: und wer ihn nicht hat, den nage der Neid!
libretto.translation: and let envy gnaw whoever does not have it!
Let each crave his own goods,

libretto.text: doch keiner genieße mit Nutzen sein!
libretto.translation: but let none enjoy it with profit!

libretto.text: Ohne Wucher hüt’ ihn sein Herr;
libretto.translation: Let its master guard it without usury;
